name: F-Series (Aria)
dof_breakdown: face, neck, arms, torso, hands and base; 17 facial motors
price_note: base F-Series hardware; a configured Aria was quoted near $175,000
summary: A full-bodied android sold as a companion and greeter, with silicone skin, seventeen facial motors and micro-cameras in the eyes for face and object recognition. The upper body sits on a motorized wheeled base, the face and skin are swappable after delivery, and the software stack is open enough to run third-party models instead of Realbotix's own.
